	(`tabPurchase Order Item`.billed_amt * ifnull(`tabPurchase Order`.conversion_rate, 1)) as "Billed Amount:Currency:100",

	`tabPurchase Order Item`.item_name as "Item Name::150",
	`tabPurchase Order Item`.description as "Description::200",
	`tabPurchase Order`.company as "Company:Link/Company:"
from
	`tabPurchase Order`, `tabPurchase Order Item`
where
	`tabPurchase Order Item`.`parent` = `tabPurchase Order`.`name`
	and `tabPurchase Order`.docstatus = 1
	and `tabPurchase Order`.status != "Closed"
        and `tabPurchase Order Item`.amount > 0
	and (`tabPurchase Order Item`.billed_amt * ifnull(`tabPurchase Order`.conversion_rate, 1)) < `tabPurchase Order Item`.base_amount
order by `tabPurchase Order`.transaction_date asc

report_bodies.name: Ordering Kit
report_bodies.query:
SELECT CURRENT_DATE, 
       tabTop3AVGSales.warehouse                                                 AS Warehouse, 
       tabTop3AVGSales.item                                                 AS Item_Name,
       tabTop3AVGSales.freq                                             AS Freq,
       tabTop3AVGSales.Cost                                             AS Unit_Cost, 
       tabTop3AVGSales.top3mavgs                                        AS AVG_MSales, 
       FLOOR((tabTop3AVGSales.top3mavgs / 2 ) - ( tabBin.actual_qty )) AS Low_Stock,
       tabBin.actual_qty                                                AS Bal_Qty,
       tabTop3AVGSales.top3mavgs - tabBin.actual_qty                    AS ReOrder_Qty 
FROM   tabBin 
       RIGHT JOIN `tabTop3AVGSales` 
               ON tabBin.warehouse = `tabTop3AVGSales`.warehouse 
                  AND tabBin.item_code = `tabTop3AVGSales`.item 
       AND tabTop3AVGSales.top3mavgs / 2 - tabBin.actual_qty > 0 
       AND tabTop3AVGSales.freq > 5 
ORDER  BY warehouse, 
          actual_qty DESC 
LIMIT  10000
